function.name: get_url_content

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re searching manually, integrating into an app, or automating the process.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical Use‑Case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Web & Mobile Booking Sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, multi‑city itineraries | Quick comparison, visual price trends |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates fares from airlines & OTAs | Best‑price hunting, flexible dates |
| | **Kayak** | Price comparison + “Price Forecast” | Budget planning, “best time to buy” |
| | **Expedia / Hotels.com** | Flights + hotels + car rentals | Bundle deals, loyalty points |
| | **Orbitz / Travelocity** | Similar to Expedia | Alternative OTA, sometimes better promos |
| | **Momondo** | Aggressive price comparison | Finds hidden deals, multi‑stop options |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing + mobile booking | “Book now or wait” decision aid |
| | **Airline Direct Sites** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Direct booking, frequent‑flyer benefits | Loyalty points, seat selection |
| | **Travel Agencies (online)** (e.g., Priceline, CheapTickets) | Discounted fares, package deals | One‑stop shop for complex itineraries |
| **API & SDKs** | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight data | Build custom flight search widgets |
| | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flights, hotels, travel commerce | Enterprise booking solutions |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑carrier itineraries, “virtual interlining” | Innovative routing, low‑cost options |
| | **Travelport API** | Global distribution system (GDS) | Airline, hotel, car rental integration |
| | **Sabre API** | GDS, flight inventory, booking | Large‑scale travel agencies |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (not booking) | Flight tracking, analytics |
| **Command‑Line / Scraping Tools** | **flight-scraper** (Python) | Scrape flight prices from sites | Quick data extraction for research |
| | **Selenium + BeautifulSoup** | Automate browsing & scrape flight data | Custom data pipelines |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Real‑time flight status | Status checks, ETA updates |
| **Voice & Chatbot Assistants** | **Google Assistant / Alexa** | Voice‑controlled flight search | Hands‑free booking |
| | **Chatbot frameworks** (Dialogflow, Rasa) + flight APIs | Conversational booking | Customer support bots |
| **Travel Management Platforms** | **Concur** | Corporate travel booking & expense | Business travel, policy compliance |
| | **SAP Ariba Travel** | Enterprise travel procurement | Large‑scale corporate booking |
| | **Egencia** | Corporate travel management | Travel policy enforcement |

### How to Choose

1. **Personal vs. Business** – For individual travelers, consumer sites (Google Flights, Skyscanner, Hopper) are usually best. For corporate travel, GDS APIs or travel‑management platforms are more appropriate.
2. **Price vs. Convenience** – Aggregators give the best price visibility; airline direct sites often offer better seat selection and loyalty perks.
3. **Automation Needs** – If you’re building an app or bot, pick a robust API (Amadeus, Skyscanner, Kiwi) that offers comprehensive flight data and booking capabilities.
4. **Data Analytics** – For research or trend analysis, consider scraping tools or flight‑tracking APIs (OpenSky, FlightRadar24).

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific tool or how to integrate one into your workflow!
